title: Eighteen GB

beats.say: My phone is full. Eighteen gigabytes of good morning pictures.
beats.show: My phone is full. 18 GB of good morning pictures.

screen.title: Storage full
screen.body:
WhatsApp: 18 GB

Good morning images: 2,314
Good morning videos: 611

beats.say: I'm so, so sorry. Clear the files, keep the chats. Uncle stays.

screen.title: Clear the files, keep the chats
screen.body:
1. Settings > Storage and data > Manage storage:
   'Forwarded many times', 'Larger than 5 MB'
2. Biggest group: select media, delete. Chats stay.
3. Media auto-download: No media
4. Group info > Media visibility: No
   (iPhone: Save to Photos: Never)

Comment CLEAN for the steps

beats.say: Done! I also backed up all eighteen gigabytes to your cloud first!
beats.show: Done! I also backed up all 18 GB to your cloud first!

beats.say: So my cloud is full now.

caption:
18 GB of good morning images. one AI fixed it by leaving the family group. mum noticed.

whatsapp > settings > storage and data > manage storage. delete the media in 'forwarded many times' and your biggest groups, and the chats stay. then set media auto-download to no media so it stops filling up.

how many GB is your whatsapp using? just the number.

Comment CLEAN and I'll DM you the 4 step cleanup for Android and iPhone, plus the settings that stop it filling up again.
